Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 41 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Ishaan - 8 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
4. Aditi - 9 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Sunita, Ishaan and Aditi stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Ishaan, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Aditi (excited): "That's easy."

[Vihaan mops the floor.]

Vihaan (excited): "I knew it!"

[Vihaan irons his school shirt.]

Vihaan: "That was such a fun day!"
